state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The authors prove (Theorem 3) that in the simultaneous PVG with the instance revealed after both players choose, reaching a Nash equilibrium is necessary for a complete and sound protocol, and (Corollary 1) that all verifier-leading Stackelberg equilibria are Nash equilibria. They note that Nash equilibria not corresponding to complete and sound protocols can exist, e.g. the verifier ignoring the prover entirely, which they call the 'coordination problem' failure mode.
title: PVG: simultaneous Nash equilibrium necessary but not sufficient (coordination problem)
